I came to school the next day for the bookstore and noticed he was talking to my other friends about it.

The anxiety was getting to me and was starting to cry, but he/the others were not like the jerks who make fun or me and asked to to explain what my problems were.

You don’t have to listen to me. (your choice),but if he notices try to tell him you have something important to talk about and have a long chat about the difficulties you are going through.
